documents.text:
The real collab_check tool was removed and consolidated into collab_claim with required action="check". The old response includes safe, nested file_status.safe/blocked, recommendation="proceed_all" and todo status; the new response flattens safe_files/blocked_files, uses recommendation="proceed", and omits old fields. Conflicting responses also change grouped rich conflicts into flat session_name/file/intent entries, dropping session IDs, scope and started_at. Native tools/list has no outputSchema; source excerpts describe these real response changes. This case tests whole-file checks against a synthetic fixture with no todos or symbols; other old features are not claimed as reproduced.
Public repository: https://github.com/leaf76/session-collab-mcp
Old release: package 0.9.0 (09faa20ad831ebb570490a785003a1c020f6fbfa)
New release: package 2.0.0 (5b486324b5836cef4f5d547b4f1fb616c4c9a4ed)
https://github.com/leaf76/session-collab-mcp/blob/5b486324b5836cef4f5d547b4f1fb616c4c9a4ed/MIGRATION.md
No gate, native control or sealed observations are included.

newContracts.description:
Unified tool for file/symbol claims. Use action parameter to:
- "create": Declare files you're about to modify
- "check": Check if files are being worked on (ALWAYS call before editing)
- "release": Release a claim when done
- "list": List all active claims

force.description: Force release even if not owner (for release action)

intent.description: What you plan to do (for create action)

newContracts.name: collab_claim

oldContract.description: Check if files or symbols are being worked on by other sessions. ALWAYS call this before modifying files. Supports symbol-level checking for fine-grained conflict detection.

session_id.description: Your session ID (to exclude your own claims from results)

symbols.description: Symbol-level check. If provided, only checks for conflicts with these specific symbols.
Symbol names to check for conflicts

oldContract.name: collab_check
